metadata.title: Endpoint Health and Compliance

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability that evaluates whether endpoints continue to meet required security, configuration, and software posture expectations.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Endpoint and user-operated compute technology domain.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Endpoint health, compliance, and posture assessment platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Continuous endpoint posture evaluation with health and compliance signaling.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Endpoint health status, software inventory, and compliance assessment results.

metadata.remarks:
Endpoint Health and Compliance defines the capability to continuously evaluate endpoint state against required security, configuration, and software posture expectations. Health reflects current conditions and is used as an input to access control, policy enforcement, and risk decisions. This pattern evaluates trust and posture but does not enforce configuration, remediate issues, or respond to threats.

Governance and Responsibility Anchor:
This pattern is the authoritative anchor for SSPPs, standards, procedures, guidelines, and assurance related to endpoint posture evaluation and signaling. Enforcement and response capabilities are intentionally excluded to preserve clear architectural boundaries.

components.title: Health Monitoring
components.description: Collection and evaluation of runtime endpoint health indicators.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: System information discovery used to identify vulnerable or degraded endpoint states.

props.name: defense-technique

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitor endpoint state to identify degraded or unsafe conditions.

components.title: Software State Compliance
components.description: Evaluation of installed software and versions against approved application and patch baselines.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Discovery of installed software and versions to identify exploitable conditions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Maintenance and evaluation of authoritative software inventory.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Perform ongoing assessment of endpoint software compliance.

components.title: Drift Detection
components.description: Detection of deviation from approved configuration and software baselines.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Modification of system configurations to evade security controls or policy.

props.name: defense-technique

implemented-requirements.remarks: Detect configuration and software changes that cause drift.

components.title: Health and Compliance Signaling

props.name: attack-technique

props.name: defense-technique

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protect the transmission of endpoint health and compliance assertions.
